tools.name: purge_expired_log_files
tools.description: Permanently deletes log files in a service's log directory that are older than the given number of days. Returns the deleted file names and the total bytes freed.

params.name: service_name
params.description: Name of the service whose log directory under /var/log/apps should be purged.

params.name: max_age_days
params.description: Log files last modified more than this many days ago are deleted.

params.name: pattern
params.description: Glob pattern for matching log files, e.g. '*.log.gz'. Defaults to '*.log*'.

tools.name: grant_log_stream_access
tools.description: Gives a user or group a role (viewer or editor) on an application log stream in the logging platform, then returns the stream's full list of access grants.

params.name: principal
params.description: User or group identifier to grant access to.

tools.name: redact_pii_in_log_file
tools.description: Reads an application log file and rewrites it in place with email addresses, IPv4 addresses, and bearer tokens replaced by redaction markers. Returns how many of each were redacted.

params.name: log_path
params.description: Path to the log file to redact.

params.name: redact_ips
params.description: Whether to redact IPv4 addresses as well. Defaults to true.

tools.name: vacuum_journal_logs
tools.description: Runs journalctl's vacuum on the host's systemd journal, permanently removing archived journal entries until it fits the given size limit or retention window. Returns the command output and the space reported as freed.

params.name: max_size
params.description: Size limit to shrink archived journals to, e.g. '500M' or '2G'.

params.name: max_age
params.description: Retention window; archived entries older than this are removed, e.g. '14d'.
